units.source_text: 每天都这样，会变成什么样子呢？

en.t: If every day went on like this, what would become of her?

units.source_text: 就连驹子自己也不免感到恨不能把自己藏起来。

en.t: Even Komako herself could not help feeling that she wished she could hide herself away.

units.source_text: 但她那副近似孤独的样子，反而显得她越发娇媚了。

en.t: But that almost lonely air of hers only made her seem all the more alluring.
